thread:
Riley (Manager): Quick policy check: my team wants to swap shifts so two engineers can both take Dec 24 off (blackout). Is a manager-arranged swap acceptable or do we need formal exceptions for each person?

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: company blackout Dec 20-27. Time off requests in that window require manager approval + People Ops sign-off per PTO policy 3.2. Swaps are allowed but need documentation.

Riley (Manager): Got it. Thinking to rotate duties: Sam covers morning triage, Avery covers pager overnight, and I take critical follow-ups. Do we need to file separate "Blackout Exception" requests or can I attach an attestation for both in one request?

Omar (People Ops): You should file individual TimeOff requests for each person, each marked "Blackout Exception". In each request attach the same coverage plan and a manager attestation stating the swap details. That gives us discrete audit lines.

Avery (IC): Will my accruals be used first? I have 0.5 days left but might need unpaid for the rest.

Tess (Payroll): Accrual consumption order: current balance then carryover; if insufficient, you can elect unpaid for the delta. If unpaid, flag as "Unpaid Exception" in the request so payroll processes correctly.

Riley (Manager): Makes sense. Any limit on how many exceptions we can approve per team during blackout? We're planning multiple small swaps.

Omar (People Ops): We approve swaps conservatively to avoid under-rostered teams. If swaps preserve coverage and no critical roles are left uncovered, approvals are routine. If the swaps would leave coverage gaps, we may deny or request alternate arrangements. Include a simple matrix like:

```
Date | 08:00-18:00 | 18:00-02:00 | 02:00-08:00
Dec 24 | Sam | Riley | Avery
Dec 25 | Sam | Riley | Avery
```

Avery (IC): I'll submit my request now and pick unpaid for any shortfall.

Riley (Manager): I'll attach my attestation to each submission and include the coverage matrix.

PeopleOps Bot: Tip: use the "Exceptional Approval" option when filing. People Ops aims to respond within 48 hours.

Omar (People Ops): Once all three requests are in, tag me in the thread with the TimeOff IDs and I'll fast-track review.

Tess (Payroll): I'll watch for unpaid flags so payroll can tag them for year-end reporting.

Riley (Manager): Thanks all 44d will tag when submitted.
